div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 700px; text-align: center;

span.p:
The one thing that is not obvious. libpq with sslmode=verify-full and no sslrootcert
looks for ~/.postgresql/root.crt, which cannot exist in Lambda — and sslrootcert=system fails
too, because psycopg's manylinux wheel bundles an OpenSSL whose compiled-in CA path is
absent from the Lambda filesystem. The stored DSN therefore ends with
sslrootcert=/etc/pki/tls/certs/ca-bundle.crt — Amazon Linux's own bundle.
